tagline: Feature Views are now available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
what_it_does: Feature Views are now available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. Feature Views enable you to define and compute features from data sources. Features can be defined using a variety of sources (Delta table, Kafka Stream, and request time data) and computations (time windowed aggregations, simple column selections, and more).
